# GitHub Copilot instructions — dtmgd

`dtmgd` is a read-only, `kubectl`-style Go CLI for Dynatrace Managed (self-hosted) clusters.

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before changing code: architecture, how to add a
command, the testing rules, CI and releases. For using the CLI, see
[skills/dtmgd/SKILL.md](../skills/dtmgd/SKILL.md).
